6943fcfe-613f-288b-782a-557300000000.instructionalDetails: Clear all vegetation. For slopes over 10°, establish contour bunds or terraces to prevent soil erosion. Ensure soil depth is at least 0.75m.

6943fcfe-613f-288b-782a-557400000000.instructionalDetails: Plant 3.0m long Gliricidia stakes at the recommended spacing (e.g., 2.5m x 2.5m). These must sprout and grow to provide shade and support for the pepper vine.

6943fcfe-613f-288b-782a-557500000000.instructionalDetails: Dig pits of 60cm x 60cm x 60cm. For hard soils, use 50cm x 50cm x 50cm. Let the pit air for 2 weeks before filling.

6943fd2d-613f-288b-782a-557700000000.instructionalDetails: Fill pits with a mixture of topsoil, 10kg of cow dung/compost, and 60g of Saphos Phosphate. Create a small mound to prevent water logging.

694402f9-613f-288b-782a-558b00000000.instructionalDetails: Panniyur-1 is highly sensitive to heavy shade. Prune the Gliricidia support branches to ensure the vine receives at least 50-60% sunlight.

6944031d-613f-288b-782a-558e00000000.instructionalDetails: Kuching is drought-tolerant but needs a strong root base. Apply a thick layer of dried leaves or coconut husks around the base.
